title: Fixing cross-loop socket reuse in Redis async cluster transactions
description: How we diagnosed and fixed two subtle asyncio event-loop bugs (#4513 & #4537) in redis/redis-py when queuing lazy and movablekeys commands on ClusterPipeline.
heroAlt: Diagram of async RedisCluster pipeline isolating worker-thread event loop sockets from caller loop pools.

title: Cutting AI agent cloud costs by 87% with isolated Orbits & sub-minute circuit breakers
description: Why autonomous agents burn runaway cloud budgets, and how VM Nebula enforces Pulsar metering and 60-second Stasis cutoffs across GCP and Azure AI Foundry.
heroAlt: VM Nebula Orbit architecture with Pulsar metering and Stasis circuit breaker.

title: Building a multimodal Urdu & Pashto voice ERP for 1,113 SKUs in Mardan Bazaar

heroAlt: Sarkit voice-to-ledger and handwritten bill OCR pipeline.
